# Theory: Migration is Mapping Names, Then Objects, Then Metadata

Git history is the easy part (`push --mirror`). Users, PRs, CI, and packages are lossy maps. A decision framework is which losses you accept.

## Invariants

1. Object hashes can stay; URLs and issue numbers usually cannot.
2. Interoperability is shared Git + webhooks, not identical UIs.
3. AI features will attach to whatever forge has the social graph.

```text
Git objects  ── lossless ──►  new forge
PRs/issues   ── best effort ──►  importer
Actions YAML ── rewrite ──►  new CI
```

## What can break

- Promising zero-loss PR comments without reading the importer docs.

## How to read this chapter

Strategies, preserving history, interoperability, trends, decision, future.
